description: This file is part of the TestLink open source testing management platform. It handles exporting test cases and test suites to XML files, manages various export options, loads configurations, and renders the export interface.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic empty class used for flexible object property assignment.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments used throughout the script based on request parameters, setting up export options and identifiers.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates and initializes a GUI object with parameters for the export interface, including titles, URLs, and user options.
